theory_signatures.title: ResNet residual block
theory_signatures.surface_text: ResNet residual block. deep_learning. A skip connection preserves input activation as an identity baseline while a residual branch learns a delta; output is x + F(x), and zero delta recovers the input.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Preserve a working identity or prior path, learn only the residual correction, and require zero correction to recover the baseline.

theory_signatures.title: Kalman innovation update
theory_signatures.surface_text: Kalman innovation update. control_estimation. The prior state estimate is the baseline path; the innovation residual forms a correction delta, and zero innovation leaves prediction unchanged.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Preserve a working identity or prior path, learn only the residual correction, and require zero correction to recover the baseline.

theory_signatures.title: Newton residual root update
theory_signatures.surface_text: Newton residual root update. numerical_math. At each root-finding step, the current guess is preserved as base point; local error residual produces a corrective update, and zero residual means fixed point.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Preserve a working identity or prior path, learn only the residual correction, and require zero correction to recover the baseline.

theory_signatures.title: Lenz law
theory_signatures.surface_text: Lenz law. electromagnetism. Changing magnetic flux perturbs a circuit; induced current opposes the flux change, and energy conservation constrains the response.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: When a perturbation induces an opposing response under a constraint, predict dampening or restoration only after checking positive-feedback controls.

theory_signatures.title: Le Chatelier equilibrium shift
theory_signatures.surface_text: Le Chatelier equilibrium shift. chemistry. A concentration or temperature disturbance displaces equilibrium; the equilibrium shift counteracts the imposed change under a free-energy constraint.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: When a perturbation induces an opposing response under a constraint, predict dampening or restoration only after checking positive-feedback controls.

theory_signatures.title: Homeostatic setpoint control
theory_signatures.surface_text: Homeostatic setpoint control. biology. Deviation from a setpoint triggers actuator response that resists disturbance and restores a stable range.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: When a perturbation induces an opposing response under a constraint, predict dampening or restoration only after checking positive-feedback controls.

theory_signatures.title: Seismic autocorrelation denoising
theory_signatures.surface_text: Seismic autocorrelation denoising. signal_processing. A coherent seismic event is the stable signal; random uncorrelated noise is suppressed by autocorrelation and stacking projection.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Prefer the predictable latent/coherent signal and suppress stochastic nuisance variation; validate that the retained structure, not the noise, carries downstream utility.

theory_signatures.title: JEPA latent prediction
theory_signatures.surface_text: JEPA latent prediction. world_modeling. Latent prediction keeps predictable world state while ignoring stochastic pixel detail and Gaussian nuisance variation.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Prefer the predictable latent/coherent signal and suppress stochastic nuisance variation; validate that the retained structure, not the noise, carries downstream utility.

theory_signatures.title: PCA noise suppression
theory_signatures.surface_text: PCA noise suppression. statistics. Project measurements onto principal component structure and discard orthogonal random noise to recover a low-dimensional signal.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Prefer the predictable latent/coherent signal and suppress stochastic nuisance variation; validate that the retained structure, not the noise, carries downstream utility.

theory_signatures.title: Randomized controlled trial
theory_signatures.surface_text: Randomized controlled trial. causal_inference. A treatment group is compared with a matched control; a single intervention is changed and outcome is measured.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Change one factor against a matched control and promote the claim only if the measured outcome beats the control without outside harm.

theory_signatures.title: A/B test
theory_signatures.surface_text: A/B test. product_experiment. A variant changes one factor from baseline; matched traffic control and outcome metric decide causal effect.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Change one factor against a matched control and promote the claim only if the measured outcome beats the control without outside harm.

theory_signatures.title: Controlled-variable physics experiment
theory_signatures.surface_text: Controlled-variable physics experiment. physics_method. The experiment isolates one variable, keeps controls fixed, changes one factor, and compares the measured outcome.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Change one factor against a matched control and promote the claim only if the measured outcome beats the control without outside harm.

theory_signatures.title: Divide and conquer
theory_signatures.surface_text: Divide and conquer. algorithm_design. Split a root problem into subproblems, solve independent parts, and compose results back through an interface contract.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Split the root problem into subproblems with explicit interfaces, then verify that composed sub-solutions recover the original goal.

theory_signatures.title: MapReduce
theory_signatures.surface_text: MapReduce. distributed_systems. Map subtasks across partitions and reduce output through a contract to recover the whole result.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Split the root problem into subproblems with explicit interfaces, then verify that composed sub-solutions recover the original goal.

theory_signatures.title: Modular proof by lemmas
theory_signatures.surface_text: Modular proof by lemmas. mathematics. Break a theorem into lemmas with interface assumptions, then compose lemmas to prove the root claim.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Split the root problem into subproblems with explicit interfaces, then verify that composed sub-solutions recover the original goal.

theory_signatures.title: Amdahl law
theory_signatures.surface_text: Amdahl law. parallel_computing. Speedup and throughput are limited by the serial bottleneck fraction; improving nonlimiting parallel work cannot raise output.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Throughput is governed by the limiting capacity; interventions should target the bottleneck, not locally attractive non-limiting stages.

theory_signatures.title: Rate-limited worker queue
theory_signatures.surface_text: Rate-limited worker queue. systems. Requests flow through a rate-limited worker queue; scarce capacity caps output, and relieving the limiter increases throughput.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Throughput is governed by the limiting capacity; interventions should target the bottleneck, not locally attractive non-limiting stages.

theory_signatures.title: Liebig law of the minimum
theory_signatures.surface_text: Liebig law of the minimum. ecology. Plant growth output is constrained by the scarcest nutrient; adding nonlimiting resources does not improve throughput.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Throughput is governed by the limiting capacity; interventions should target the bottleneck, not locally attractive non-limiting stages.

theory_signatures.title: Popper falsifiability
theory_signatures.surface_text: Popper falsifiability. philosophy_of_science. A hypothesis must expose falsifiable predictions; a counterexample breaks an overbroad claim and forces revision.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: A counterexample should falsify an overbroad claim and force a narrower, testable repair.

theory_signatures.title: Proof by counterexample
theory_signatures.surface_text: Proof by counterexample. mathematics. One counterexample disproves a universal statement; the refined theorem narrows conditions.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: A counterexample should falsify an overbroad claim and force a narrower, testable repair.

theory_signatures.title: Counterexample-guided synthesis
theory_signatures.surface_text: Counterexample-guided synthesis. program_synthesis. A candidate program is checked against counterexample traces, then patched with a guardrail repair.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: A counterexample should falsify an overbroad claim and force a narrower, testable repair.

theory_signatures.title: Energy conservation
theory_signatures.surface_text: Energy conservation. physics. A state transformation preserves total energy; the before/after balance check closes.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: A transformation is valid only if the conserved quantity or budget balances before and after.

theory_signatures.title: Kirchhoff current law
theory_signatures.surface_text: Kirchhoff current law. circuit_theory. Charge conservation means current entering a node equals current leaving, preserving flow balance.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: A transformation is valid only if the conserved quantity or budget balances before and after.

theory_signatures.title: Probability mass normalization
theory_signatures.surface_text: Probability mass normalization. probability. A transition reallocates probability mass, but normalization keeps total probability one and the balance closes.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: A transformation is valid only if the conserved quantity or budget balances before and after.

theory_signatures.title: Lyapunov descent
theory_signatures.surface_text: Lyapunov descent. dynamical_systems. An ordered state update uses a Lyapunov energy objective that never increases; regression is rejected until stable.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Accept an iterative update only when it preserves the relevant order/objective and detects regression.

theory_signatures.title: Policy iteration improvement
theory_signatures.surface_text: Policy iteration improvement. reinforcement_learning. A new policy is accepted only if the value objective is non-decreasing over ordered states.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Accept an iterative update only when it preserves the relevant order/objective and detects regression.

theory_signatures.title: Coordinate ascent lower bound
theory_signatures.surface_text: Coordinate ascent lower bound. optimization. Each coordinate step improves the lower bound objective and rejects updates that reverse progress order.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Accept an iterative update only when it preserves the relevant order/objective and detects regression.

theory_signatures.title: Fourier transform
theory_signatures.surface_text: Fourier transform. mathematics. Transform a signal from time representation to frequency representation so convolution becomes multiplication; the inverse preserves information.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Move to an information-preserving representation where the hard operation becomes simpler, then map back while checking the preserved invariant.

theory_signatures.title: Laplace transform
theory_signatures.surface_text: Laplace transform. differential_equations. Map a differential equation to an algebraic representation, solve the simpler operation, then invert to recover the original trajectory.
theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Move to an information-preserving representation where the hard operation becomes simpler, then map back while checking the preserved invariant.

theory_signatures.title: Log transform for products

theory_signatures.abstract_claim: Move to an information-preserving representation where the hard operation becomes simpler, then map back while checking the preserved invariant.
